THE ONE-SHA BINDING IS MECHANICAL, NOT PROCEDURAL, which is what step 3 asks for. implementationPlan.description: DoD 1 — EVERY L1-L5 GATE PRINTS PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN with correct tails, multiplicity, margins and comparator indexing. Print against the HAND-TRANSCRIBED roster FROZEN_GATE_IDS (pre-freeze-audit-rosters.ts:23-27), never against a set derived from the campaign's own output — that file's header explains why a roster computed from the same scan it checks cannot disagree with it. USE THE LANDED TRIVALENT RESOLVER `resolveRungVerdict` (pre-freeze-gate-audit.ts:38) rather than writing a second one: it already encodes FAIL-dominates and empty-or-any-UNKNOWN-is-UNKNOWN, and a campaign that re-derives its own verdict rule is a competing authority over the question it exists to answer. TAILS AND MARGINS ARE PER-GATE AND EASY TO INVERT SILENTLY: acceptance is higher-is-better so the LOWER 95% CI bound detects Moe being worse, and its margin is `M_accept_x`, NEVER the fan-out `M_accept` (:88); cost non-inferiority is a paired log-ratio with an UPPER 95% CI bound against `M_cost`, and the 5x `Γ_cost` ceiling is NEVER reused as "matching cost" (:89); quality NI additionally carries a hard floor of ZERO critical-severity/BLOCKER regression, where a single critical regression FAILs the gate (:88). Comparator-indexed gates are AND-ed across all m, and L5 is an intersection-union test over >= C_min model-matched members. SHOW PROPAGATION EXPLICITLY: when an upper rung is UNKNOWN because a lower one was, print it as inherited rather than as independently measured, or the report overstates how much was evaluated.

implementationPlan.description: DoD 2 — KEEP EVERY STATEMENT INSIDE THE PERMIT LIST. Spec :81: "Grammar is permit-list, not forbid-list: each rung enumerates the ONLY sentence templates it licenses (each with mandatory scope); any sentence not affirmatively permitted at the reached rung is forbidden, at every rung, INCLUDING SYNONYMS ('safest', 'more reliable', 'higher quality', 'production-ready')". The seven statement families are cost, acceptance, effort, speed, quality, overhead and safety. Emit the single permitted sentence for the highest ALL-PASS rung and nothing above it; if the highest all-PASS rung is L0/none, emit that, and emit no comparative or superlative word anywhere. RAIL 1 GOVERNS EVERY FAMILY: missing, partial, cross-basis or unverifiable evidence is UNKNOWN, never PASS — and an unattested corpus does not become attested because the custody gate was lifted. Specific traps the spec calls out: a consumed-dimension PARTIAL on any cost gate resolves it UNKNOWN and is never silently treated as complete (:337); imputation is permitted ONLY for the self-paired ceiling gate G-L3-cost and is FORBIDDEN for any cross-arm cost gate, because imputing a competitor's unknown cost at its maximum would flatter Moe (:337); quality NI establishes "matching", never "leading", and is not superiority-eligible (:89); the one-directional capability matrix is NOT L5 evidence (:89); capability-absent facets never score as Moe speed or quality wins (:191). If step 1 determined the gates are structurally UNKNOWN, the permitted output is the L0/none sentence — write it, and do not reach for a weaker claim that sounds sayable.
implementationPlan.note:
STEP 5 / DoD 2 — THE L0 SENTENCE, AND NOTHING THAT SOUNDS SAYABLE.

THE EMITTED STATEMENT, verbatim and complete:
  "L0: no rung was reached, so this campaign licenses no cost, acceptance, effort, speed, quality, overhead, or safety sentence."
That is the whole output. The highest all-PASS rung is L0, so the permit list licenses nothing above it, and I did not reach for a softer claim that would have read as sayable.

ALL SEVEN FAMILIES ARE PRESENT AND ALL SEVEN ARE EMPTY, which is the mechanical form of "inside the permit list": cost, acceptance, effort, speed, quality, overhead, safety — each `{status: "UNKNOWN", sentence: null}`. The checker asserts the family list EQUALS those seven in order and that every `sentence` is null, so a later edit cannot slip a sentence into one family or quietly drop a family from the list.

THE SYNONYM BAN IS ENFORCED, NOT PROMISED. Spec :81 makes the grammar a permit-list and extends the ban to synonyms, so the checker lowercases the emitted statement and rejects it if it contains any of: faster, fastest, cheaper, cheapest, better, best, safer, safest, "more reliable", "higher quality", "production-ready", leading, superior, outperform, "non-inferior", "noninferior", wins, beats, matches, matching. `matches`/`matching` and `non-inferior` are in that list ON PURPOSE — quality NI establishes matching and never leading (:89), so at L0 even the modest-sounding word is unlicensed.

THE FOUR NAMED TRAPS, each avoided and recorded rather than merely not-triggered:
  - Consumed-dimension PARTIAL resolving a cost gate as complete (:337): no cost gate is complete; G-L3-cost, G-L5-cost and G-L3-budget are all UNKNOWN.
  - Cross-arm cost imputation (:337): NONE performed. Imputation is licensed only for the self-paired ceiling gate G-L3-cost, and imputing a competitor's unknown cost at its maximum would flatter Moe. With zero units there was nothing to impute from, and the record says imputation was not used.
  - The 5x Gamma_cost ceiling reused as "matching cost" (:89): not reused; recorded as the rule that would apply, never as a result.
  - The one-directional capability matrix as L5 evidence, and capability-absent facets scoring as Moe speed or quality wins (:89, :191): no matrix exists — :208's product-by-scenario COMPARABLE/ADAPTED/ABSENT classification is one of the freeze's UNKNOWN declarations — so nothing was scored in either direction.

RAIL 1 GOVERNS EVERY FAMILY AND IS HONOURED AT THE HARDEST POINT: an unattested corpus does not become attested because the custody gate was lifted. `readConfirmatoryFreezeAuthority()` still refuses with CONFIRMATORY_FREEZE_AUTHORITY_UNASSIGNED, the freeze says UNATTESTED in those words, and the record's scope section states plainly that a lifted gate is not an earned attestation.

WHY THIS OUTPUT IS THE VALUABLE ONE RATHER THAN A FAILURE. Step 2's determination (comment-30fee94f, comment-0e3f7b35) established that 18 of 20 gates depend on Moe-independent authorship whose carrier is the hash-committed manifest's affiliations — not the custody attestation — and that carrier is absent. So a campaign run today would have printed exactly these verdicts at whatever it cost to run. Recording L0 with the reason is the honest result; manufacturing a runnable-looking campaign around absent evidence would have been the proof-of-shapes failure the epic calls worse than no proof.

implementationPlan.description: DoD 3 AND CLOSE-OUT — THE INDEPENDENT DECISION-RULE CHECKER, then the durable record and the honest scope statement. RUN THE INDEPENDENT DECISION-RULE CHECKER AND REQUIRE IT TO PASS. "Independent" is the whole point: it must RE-DERIVE the verdicts from the recorded data and the frozen rules rather than trusting the campaign's own analysis output. If the checker consumes the campaign's computed verdicts instead of the underlying records, it is not independent and its PASS certifies nothing — report that as a finding rather than accepting the green. Verify it exercises the roster BIDIRECTIONALLY: every advertised gate id is decided, AND every decided gate id is advertised, asserted as SET EQUALITY rather than subset, so a gate that silently vanishes from the report reddens instead of shrinking the check with it. THEN: post every load-bearing claim to a DURABLE comment via moe.add_comment — counts with denominators, the per-unit censoring dispositions with the rule applied to each, the twenty per-gate verdicts marked measured-or-inherited, the step-1 attestation-dependency table, and the exact permitted sentence emitted. The completion summary is write-only and is persisted nowhere, so a claim made only there is graded against a field that does not exist. STATE THE SCOPE HONESTLY: name what the campaign did NOT establish, especially anything resting on unverifiable independence, and do not let a lifted custody gate be read as an earned attestation. Commit by EXPLICIT PATHSPEC over this row's owned paths only — immutable campaign outputs and release evidence — never `git add -A`, never push, merge, reset or stash, and leave no probe or scratch file in the commit.
